payload.title: Fortnite returns to Google Play worldwide after Epic antitrust win
payload.content: Epic Games has restored Fortnite to Google Play globally following its landmark antitrust victory against Google. A US federal judge ordered Google to open its app store to competing payment systems and restore previously removed apps. Epic CEO Tim Sweeney called the ruling a turning point for the mobile gaming ecosystem, as it could force platform holders to allow third-party payment processing. Analysts estimate Fortnite's return to Android could add $200-400M in annual revenue for Epic by bypassing Google's 30% commission.
